# qualys_vm_option_profiles (Data Source)

Look up Qualys VM scan option profiles, for referencing profiles managed
outside Terraform from scan schedules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qualys_vm_option_profiles" "initial" {
  title_contains = "Initial"
}

output "initial_profile_id" {
  value = one([for p in data.qualys_vm_option_profiles.initial.option_profiles : p.id])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **title_contains** (String) Filter results to profiles whose title contains this substring (case-insensitive). Applied client-side, after the API call — the list API takes no server-side title filter.

### Read-Only

- **option_profiles** (List of Object) Matching option profiles, ordered by ID for stable output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--option_profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--option_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `option_profiles`

Read-Only:
